prosody_instruction: Speak confidently and steadily, with clear declarative tone. Decisive pacing, even rhythm, no filler words.

chunks.text: I’m mapping out a Beijing trip and I’ve been thinking a lot about which attractions to squeeze in while I’m there.
After that I’m heading down to Nanjing for a couple days, and I’m planning to line up a doctor visit while I’m in town.
Oh and I’ve been keeping an eye on some medicine stuff too, mostly just checking what’s available and what I should have on hand for the trip.
For the Beijing part, I’ve got Great Wall Badaling on the calendar for 2026-04-29 in the afternoon, and it’s under Sun Lei’s name.

And in Nanjing, the appointment is with Fang Ming on 2026-05-06 for Li Na—also, there are 2 of us going to the Great Wall that day, so we’re kind of juggling schedules and all that, and then I was thinking about what to pack for the rest of the week…
